roster.name: Audiovisual Core (TDWG)
roster.description: A TDWG metadata vocabulary (set of vocabularies) for describing biodiversity-related multimedia resources and collections. Includes a main term list and multiple controlled vocabularies (content description, format, subjectOrientation, subjectPart, subtype, variant, etc.), normative structure and term-list documents, usage guides and recommended serializations (RDF, XML, CSV), and ongoing extensions (e.g., 3D imagery terms). Maintained by the Audiovisual Core Maintenance Group under Biodiversity Information Standards (TDWG).
